verdicts.justification: Rebuilt wheel+sdist myself (python -m build to scratchpad). Build log line 611: "adding 'hypertools-dev/bin/activate_this.py'"; unzip -l wheel: "2383  07-02-2026 12:30   hypertools-dev/bin/activate_this.py"; top_level.txt reads "hypertools\nhypertools-dev"; sdist also contains hypertools-1.0.0.dev0/hypertools-dev/bin/activate_this.py. After pip install of the wheel into a fresh 3.13 venv, site-packages contains a 'hypertools-dev' directory. A stray local-venv file installs into every user's site-packages.

config.ini absent from both wheel and sdist (unzip -l / tar -tzf grep 'config.ini': no hit; installed site-packages/hypertools/core/ has no config.ini). In fresh 3.13 venv with the wheel: get_default_options()['reduce'] printed "reduce defaults: {}", apply_defaults('reduce', {'ndims': 5}) printed "merged: {'ndims': 5}" then "KeyError: 'algorithm'". Source-tree reference (repo .venv) printed "reduce defaults: {'ndims': '3', 'algorithm': 'IncrementalPCA'}" and "algorithm: IncrementalPCA". Kept major (not critical): top-level hyp.reduce(x) and hyp.plot(x) still succeeded on the wheel install, so the degradation is silent-empty-defaults + KeyError on the apply_defaults path rather than total breakage.

uv venv --python 3.13 + uv pip install <wheel>: dry-run resolved "+ llvmlite==0.36.0 / + numba==0.53.1 / + umap-learn==0.5.12"; real install exited 1 with "RuntimeError: Cannot install on Python version 3.13.12; only versions >=3.6,<3.10 are supported" and "help: `llvmlite` (v0.36.0) was included because `hypertools` (v1.0.0.dev0) depends on `umap-learn` (v0.5.12) which depends on `numba` (v0.53.1)"; afterwards import matplotlib/hypertools fails (nothing installed). uv 3.14 dry-run also resolves numba==0.53.1. Contrast confirmed: pip on the same 3.13 installed numba 0.66.0 + llvmlite 0.48.0 and hypertools works. uv is a mainstream installer, so this is a real user-facing install failure fixable with a numba/llvmlite floor in hypertools deps.
commands_run: uv pip install --python <scratch>/uv313/bin/python <wheel> (exit 1, llvmlite 0.36.0 build failure)
uv venv --python 3.14 <scratch>/uv314; uv pip install --dry-run ... (also numba==0.53.1)

verdicts.justification: tar -tzf sdist shows only 'hypertools-1.0.0.dev0/tests/' plus flat test_*.py; repo tests/ additionally has __init__.py, context.py, matplotlibrc, data/, and subdirs (align, cluster, core, io, manip, plot, predict, reduce, external, impute) — all absent from the archive. Non-runnable is fair: e.g. tests/test_load_sources.py line 206 reads (Path(__file__).parent / 'data' / ...), and tests/data is not shipped.

unzip -p wheel .dist-info/METADATA | grep '](images/' returns exactly 8 relative refs starting with "![Hypertools logo](images/hypercube.png)" and "![Hypertools example](images/hypertools.gif)". Relative repo paths do not resolve from pypi.org, so the project page would show 8 broken images.

All three parts reproduce: dist/ contains hypertools-0.8.2-py3-none-any.whl + hypertools-0.8.2.tar.gz (dated Jan 29 01:12); 'git check-ignore -v hypertools-dev' prints nothing and exits 1 (not ignored, and the hypertools-dev venv dir exists at repo root); hypertools.egg-info/top_level.txt reads "hypertools\nhypertools-dev" and its mtime updated to my build time (Jul 12 15:50:49 2026), proving python -m build refreshes the in-tree egg-info.

Ran hyp.save('/tmp/x5f.hyp', np.zeros((3,3))) (np.save-style argument order) in the repo venv: exact claimed traceback "File .../hypertools/io/save.py, line 21, in save / with open(fname, 'wb') as f: / TypeError: expected str, bytes or os.PathLike object, not ndarray". Source check: save(obj, fname, **kwargs) never uses **kwargs, and the module docstring itself invokes the numpy.save analogy ("the same trust model as `numpy.save`"). Style/UX polish, not a correctness bug — agreed.
commands_run: env MPLBACKEND=Agg /Users/jmanning/hypertools/.venv/bin/python -c "import numpy as np, hypertools as hyp; hyp.save('/tmp/x5f.hyp', np.zeros((3,3)))"

verdicts.justification: hypertools/config.py lines 1-5 are exactly the claimed try/except with comment "# Fallback for Python < 3.8" importing importlib_metadata; pyproject.toml sets requires-python = ">=3.10", so the fallback is dead code (and importlib_metadata is not a declared dependency, so the fallback would ImportError anyway).

pyproject classifiers list only 3.10/3.11/3.12/3.13. Machine default python3 is 3.14.4. uv dry-run on 3.14 exits 0 (resolves umap-learn 0.5.12, though to old numba 0.53.1); pip dry-run on 3.14 exits 0 and resolves modern numba 0.66.0 + llvmlite 0.48.0, so the dependency set genuinely resolves on 3.14. Fair as an enhancement: add a 3.14 classifier once CI covers it, or document the ceiling.
